_description: U34: Configurable memory caps — relax hard limits

loop_state.description: Per-session loop state file. Default 3KB, max 16KB. Warning at 80%.

knowledge_distill.description: Knowledge distillation file. Default 8KB, max 32KB. Warning at 80%.

session_state.description: Session state JSON. Default 4KB, max 64KB. Warning at 85%.

registry.description: Session registry. Default 2KB, max 8KB. Warning at 80%.

behavior.description: U34: Memory caps are now soft limits. Warnings instead of hard stops. Truncate oldest entries when max exceeded.

project_overrides._comment: Projects can override caps by adding entries here. Key = project name, value = cap overrides.
